notes.title: Achievement Fix Update!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40541921/975d8420b9a55bca03b726bc28a133c12a8d0d65.jpg"]



Hey everyone!

Sorry for the long silence! We’re back with some partially good news! 😊 We’ve updated the game build, and now achievements should work properly for everyone! To unlock an achievement, just go to sleep in the cabin (sometimes they don’t trigger right away, so be patient).

That’s all the good news for now. We’re currently waiting for our artist to be able to continue working on the next part of the game. Thanks for your awesome feedback—it really helps us out! And a huge thank you for staying part of our community—you guys are amazing! 💪

notes.title: Final release and machine localization
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40541921/974edde53f642caeef9bbdd04ea302c0dc53ba69.png

Hello everyone from the Hotbunny team! We've got some news to share regarding the project.

As we've mentioned before, we can't continue development on the sequel or other "Pirates" universe games because part of the team is on an indefinite pause. 

However, Hotbunny is eager to resume work as soon as all team members are back in action!

Today, some of the team managed to implement machine translations for several languages and fixed some issues that were bugging players. From today, we're officially releasing the game from Early Access. Thanks for sticking with us and enjoying the game all this time. Here's hoping we'll return to normal operations soon!

Here's what's been updated:

Fixed translations for Russian and English.

Added machine translations for:

 German
 Italian
 Spanish
 Czech
 Chinese
 Vietnamese




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40541921/93c220c17fbea56296e549d14f19e10595899eee.png

notes.title: DLC Release "Sea Devil Story"!

We're happy to tell you that we've finished the dlc!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1577040/Pirates_Golden_Tits_Sea_Devil_Story/

The dlc includes:
[olist]
 7 new characters.
 10 new backgrounds.
 6 erotic scenes and more!
 A new mini-game.
 Story about the *Marine Devil*.
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40541921/20e9f57df9e510660faddaf7bcb25e2f9f9b3a2b.png

In this update, together with the dlc, we also added two scenes with the tavern-keeper's daughter ( with Molly ) and thus ended the series of meetings with her.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40541921/d3715933c6640c6e7ab002432356903c39470a80.png

What will happen next?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40541921/cffe8f0c9d5e1665b57eed205acc0907d46468ea.png

We'll continue to improve the main game. After all, there's still quite a few logical/questionable holes. And also wanted to add a lot of erotic scenes, where they should be.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40541921/4156b17ef77c8d8171352f55716748e51ae00854.jpg

Also, we have plans to finalize the content with Melissa, add her to the bathhouse and not only!

We'll let you know about the rest of the plans later! Thank you for staying with us and supporting us! Without you there wouldn't be this game and these updates!
Yo-ho-ho
